description.p: Termeric is a GPU-accelerated terminal emulator for Linux desktops on Wayland and X11, themed around roots and rhizomes. It keeps your shells in tabs, panes, and windows, and understands what your shell and tools are doing.

ul.li: Tabs, split panes, and windows, with layout presets, zoom, and broadcast input
Workspaces that save your windows, tabs, panes, folders, and scrollback
Root-named and community themes, and your own
Ligatures, color emoji, wide characters, and a font fallback chain you control
Inline images with the Kitty graphics protocol, Sixel, and iTerm2
Shell integration for Bash, Zsh, Fish, Nushell, and Elvish
Search, keyboard copy mode, and quick-select hints
A command palette, a Settings dialog, rebindable shortcuts, and a quick-access drop-down terminal

description.p: This is a developer preview. Coding-agent integration and scripting a running Termeric are experimental.
The first release: a developer preview for Linux, on Wayland and X11.
